findings.title: Fake event invites combine Kali365 and VoidProxy payloads
findings.summary_md: Push Security published its analysis of a campaign that lured victims with fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations. The registration pages combined two phishing-as-a-service platforms: Kali365 for Microsoft device-code phishing and VoidProxy as an adversary-in-the-middle reverse proxy that stole Google sign-in session cookies. Push Security said it detected and blocked visits to the malicious pages in late October 2026.

findings.title: Major Cyber Attacks in July 2026: US and Europe Targeted
findings.summary_md: ANY.RUN published a roundup documenting a multi-flow phishing campaign that abused legitimate Zoom event pages to advertise fake partner summits for Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The invitations led to device-code phishing and adversary-in-the-middle attacks. The roundup was published on August 4, 2026, covering activity from July 2026.
